verdict.rationale: Fathom documents an official MCP server, hosted at https://api.fathom.ai/mcp, that connects its meeting data to ChatGPT, Claude and any MCP-compatible tool. Setup is documented as an official Claude connector and through a `claude mcp add` command for Claude Code, and a probe confirmed the MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the server working, and documentation of the specific tools and capabilities the MCP server exposes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Fathom now offers an official MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, allowing you to connect your Fathom meeting data to AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and more.
Connect Fathom to any MCP-compatible tool using the server URL below, then authenticate to access your meeting data.
claude mcp add fathom -- npx mcp-remote@latest https://api.fathom.ai/mcp
Fathom is available as an **official connector** in Claude
